command:
set -eu
before_curl=$(rpm -q curl)
before_libcurl=$(rpm -q libcurl)
before_kernel=$(uname -r)
before_release=$(cat /etc/redhat-release)
printf '%s\n' "before-curl=$before_curl" "before-libcurl=$before_libcurl" "before-kernel=$before_kernel" "before-release=$before_release"
printf '%s\n' '--- yum parses configured exclusions ---'
python -c 'import yum; y=yum.YumBase(); print("exclude=" + " ".join(y.conf.exclude))'
printf '%s\n' '--- full system update attempt ---'
sudo yum -y update
printf '%s\n' '--- post-update comparison ---'
after_curl=$(rpm -q curl)
after_libcurl=$(rpm -q libcurl)
after_kernel=$(uname -r)
after_release=$(cat /etc/redhat-release)
printf '%s\n' "after-curl=$after_curl" "after-libcurl=$after_libcurl" "after-kernel=$after_kernel" "after-release=$after_release"
[ "$before_curl" = "$after_curl" ]
[ "$before_libcurl" = "$after_libcurl" ]
[ "$before_kernel" = "$after_kernel" ]
[ "$before_release" = "$after_release" ]
echo 'update-preservation=PASS'
